title: Sovereign Briefing: A First Receipted Human-in-the-Loop Critical Resolution in SQUIRL OS, an Autonomous Self-Healing Infrastructure (N10-ACK)
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE — READ FIRST: This record is part of an open-book, AI-assisted research program published under an audit-and-correction doctrine. Every record is audited; errors are corrected only through disclosed, versioned amendments (original versions preserved in the version history). Audit ledger and correction receipts: github.com/LLong2026/squirrel-os-lindy-test. This material is a prototype, provided for educational and research purposes only; it is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments.

Prepared for governance, security, and audit audiences. This briefing documents the first known end-to-end human-in-the-loop critical-resolution cycle in an autonomous self-healing infrastructure recorded as a deterministic, publicly timestamped receipt trail: detect → hold (refusal to auto-heal a cryptographic flow) → constitutional check → PQC validation → named human acknowledgment → heal (22 s) → resolve.

Sections: (1) what happened; (2) why it matters — converting asserted oversight into receipted, third-party-verifiable oversight; (3) substrate families involved (deterministic Substrate A, certified by SDR-1; bifurcated Substrate B, probabilistic proposer under deterministic cage); (4) the governance doctrine that fired (human-in-the-loop gate, constitutional audit as deterministic protocol, playbook immutability, confidence thresholding, full-context audit mandate, redaction at ingestion); (5) PQC lineage enforced (CRYSTALS-Dilithium3-only rotation, non-PQC fallback rejected, crypto-agility schema); (6) why this is a first, with the unreceipted prior event honestly distinguished.

Evidence of record: public append-only ledger — github.com/LLong2026/four-horsemen (entries 0009–0010, commits 700ea1e, c1f43bb, ccf691a) — and the archived achievement paper (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23151356).

Disclosures: synthetic chaos-injection probe (Night 10) on a simulated target (SIM-B corpus, formerly SIMZ); no real tenant, customer, or live cryptographic operation. Disclosed manual recovery of a scheduled workflow whose spawned session lacked cross-app write access; prior nights N7–N9 recorded as missed, not backfilled. Zero PII, credentials, wallet addresses, or transaction amounts persisted.

Patent cross-reference: pending application 64/157,915 (Deterministic Constitutional Autonomous Infrastructure Systems and Methods, filed 2026-09-18); post-filing defensive disclosure. Companions: Governed Manifold Specification v1.1 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23132046); PQC Lineage Map v1.2 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22863667).
